documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Uniparts India reported strong Q1 FY27 performance with 27% revenue growth and 55% EBITDA growth year-on-year. Management highlighted that construction equipment demand remains robust, while large agricultural equipment is currently at a cyclical bottom with recovery expected in 2027. The company is actively evaluating acquisition opportunities in hydraulics, PTOs, and fabrication to drive future growth. Operations in Mexico are on track with warehouse deliveries expected to commence in Q3 FY27. Uniparts India reported strong Q1 FY27 performance with 27% revenue growth and 64% PAT growth year-on-year.

guidance.claim: The company expects FY27 growth to be a few percentage points higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: And keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: The company expects growth in FY27 to be in line with the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: Management expects the second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half.
guidance.quote: And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

demand_outlook.claim: The construction equipment segment is performing well, supported by infrastructure-led spending in the U.S. and Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the U.S. and the government-led investments in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Large agricultural equipment is currently at a cyclical bottom, with recovery anticipated in calendar year 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket demand was impacted by tariff-driven price volatility, but is expected to normalize.
demand_outlook.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing. With tariffs having since come down, we expect this to normalize and the segment to return to growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending in the US and Europe is supporting healthy customer schedules in the construction equipment segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: The large agriculture segment is experiencing a cyclical bottom in CY2026 with recovery expected in CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: The construction equipment market in North America is expected to see continued growth in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market is projected to grow by approximately 5% in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for the quarter was INR12 crores, focused on capacity and productivity.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: The Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries expected in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: The finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is being restored on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule, and I am pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's capex plans remain consistent at 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains a target of 20% EBITDA margin over the business cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We are going to deliver FY27 also very comfortably over the 20% plus margin, right? Where they stack up, obviously depends on how the industry recovery happens, how much of warehousing sale is there and how the currency plays out.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation continues to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Management believes a 20% EBITDA margin is sustainable over the cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects to operate comfortably above the 20% EBITDA margin level as volumes build in FY27.
margins_costs.quote: And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

orders_capacity.claim: The trailing 12-month new business order book is over INR225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

capital_allocation.claim: The company ended the quarter with a net cash position of approximately INR190 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We ended quarter with net cash position of approximately INR190 crores, underlining the strength of our cash generation capabilities and financial discipline.

capital_allocation.claim: Management is actively evaluating acquisition opportunities in hydraulics, PTOs, and fabrication.
capital_allocation.quote: We also want to ensure that we are looking at hydraulics, PTOs and fabrications to add a meaningful platform, right, to our current business.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is actively evaluating acquisition opportunities to accelerate its strategic agenda.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company distributed a total dividend of INR170 crores for FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

risks_headwinds.claim: The West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire incident occurred in the finishing shop of a Ludhiana facility during Q3 FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: Escalation in West Asia in March introduced supply chain uncertainty.
risks_headwinds.quote: In March, a fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty that required swift action.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the fabrication vertical to become a meaningful vertical.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the aftermarket segment to normalize over the next 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: And I think over the next 12 months, we do expect this to normalize.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to have the fire-damaged facility back online by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Right. So, Sunil, the efforts are underway to rebuild and to be online by the end of the year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
